_meta.description: Indicators of UK employment growth for the Labour Market Nowcast (labour_nowcast.py), following Bank of England staff's indicator-based measure of underlying employment growth (Monetary Policy Report, from May 2025): a dynamic factor model (Doz, Giannone and Reichlin, 2011) on monthly indicators from the Bank's Agents, the DMP survey, HMRC, KPMG/REC, Lloyds, the ONS and S&P Global, scaled to LFS employment growth over 2000-19.

field_reference.transform: level, or growth3 (% change on three months earlier)
field_reference.factor: true: enters the factor model; false: shown for comparison only
field_reference.ticker_bloomberg: Bloomberg-only surveys: set and verify the ticker on the Terminal (python scripts/probe_catalogue.py data/series_catalogue_labour_uk.json); null = not used

series.name: Agents' employment intentions
series.notes: Agents' score for employment intentions over the next six months (new scores).

series.name: Agents' recruitment difficulties
series.notes: Agents' score for recruitment difficulties: a measure of labour demand relative to supply.

series.name: DMP realised employment growth
series.notes: Decision Maker Panel: firms' employment growth over the past year (from 2017).

series.name: DMP expected employment growth
series.notes: Decision Maker Panel: firms' expected employment growth over the next year (from 2017).

series.name: HMRC payrolled employees
series.notes: PAYE RTI payrolled employees (from mid-2014); the latest month is a flash estimate, often revised.

series.name: ONS vacancies
series.notes: ONS Vacancy Survey, three months to (from 2001).

series.name: S&P Global UK services PMI: employment
series.notes: Used by the Bank; proprietary, Bloomberg only.

series.name: S&P Global UK manufacturing PMI: employment
series.notes: Used by the Bank; proprietary, Bloomberg only.

series.name: KPMG/REC permanent placements
series.notes: KPMG/REC UK Report on Jobs; used by the Bank; Bloomberg only.

series.name: KPMG/REC temporary billings
series.notes: KPMG/REC UK Report on Jobs; Bloomberg only.

series.name: Lloyds Business Barometer: staffing expectations
series.notes: Used by the Bank; Bloomberg only.
